notes: Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the composed cues are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/ambience/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files or their cue bindings.

Ambience cues loop by construction (1.5 s tail wrap); the seam block records the checkpoint-07 indicator, not a seamlessness PASS. No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes.
Loudness targets are the ported cues' measured integrated LUFS from checkpoint 07, so a composed bed sits at the same mix level the P0 draft mixes were designed around.
Crowd beds are filtered noise only: no voice, no words, no intelligible speech is possible by construction.
